The story so far

How to refold a brand.

1

The boat you grew up with.

Paper Boat made its name bottling memories: aam panna, jaljeera and the drinks of a hundred Indian summers.

2

Unfold it. Keep the paper.

Same makers, same love of real flavour, same respect for the Indian palate. That part does not change.

3

Refold it for right now.

Paper Boat Zero: no sugar, real fizz, and a fold for every moment, from the 4 pm slump to the house party.
